verdict.rationale: Thoropass evidence shows auditors can access audit details, evidence requests, and comments/status updates directly in-platform (e.g., 'List audits and view audit details,' 'Add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests', unified comms in one page), which reduces PDF/email threads. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated, permission-scoped 'auditor view' role/UI distinct from internal user roles, nor confirmation that external auditors themselves (not just internal admins/agents) log in with a restricted view. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a scoped/external auditor role or portal, auditor-specific permissions model, and independent confirmation that auditors actually work directly in-platform rather than via exports.
